verdict.rationale: Persona's docs say webhooks can notify your service about events on any Persona resource, with real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review. That covers reacting to outcomes without polling. Developers can also filter which events arrive, set custom headers, and authenticate outbound deliveries with OAuth 2.0 client credentials. missing for 10: explicit evidence of payload signature verification (e.g. HMAC signing secret), an enumerated event list confirming created/processing lifecycle events, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
